title: Icon Buttons
summary: Native icon-only action with token geometry, accessible naming and shared loading semantics.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Extra classes applied to the inner icon button element.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

kind.description: What the icon button is: an ordinary icon action or a close control.

height.description: The control height (owner decisions C27, C35), as on sf-button: size sets the icon and the inner scale, height picks the control height from the size's tightness steps -- low, default, high, highest, the size's usual step and its neighbours on the UI height ladder. The button stays square: the step is the padding on all four sides. Desktop 1/3 24/28/32/40, 1/2 28/32/40/48, 1 32/40/48/56, 2 40/48/56/68, 3 48/56/68/80; phone 1/3 20/24/28/36, 1/2 24/28/36/44, 1 28/36/44/52, 2 36/44/52/64, 3 44/52/64/76. A compact region (data-sf-density) shifts the steps one down. kind="close" takes the same heights. A value outside the list reads as default.

appearance.description: How the icon button looks, one ladder from the strongest (rule C15): default (filled), tonal, outline, ghost (no fill or edge until a pointer or the keyboard reaches it). link is ghost's former name; surface was retired and is drawn as tonal with the on-surface scheme.

scheme.description: Which colour family the control takes (rule C15): primary, on-surface (the neutral, the text colour) or on-surface-variant (the quiet neutral: a window's head, a table row, a field's clear; under a pointer its glyph darkens to on-surface). A filled (default) control keeps on-surface's inverse glyph with on-surface-variant: on a dark fill there is no quieter step. secondary was retired and is drawn as on-surface-variant. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

status.description: What the control is about (rule C13): danger, a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone. It paints with the error roles -- the red of an error -- and behaves exactly like a primary control. error is its former name on a control.

segment.description: Joined-control position owned by Button Group composition.

filled.description: Use the filled glyph axis for the standard icon variant.

loading.description: Loading state: the spinner in place of the icon, at the icon's size, in the page's look (data-sf-spinner). Sets aria-busy and disables the native button.

badge-count.description: A count on the icon button (simai/ui-source#12): a whole number above 0 shows, 0 or empty hides the badge. Above badge-cap it reads «<cap>+»; the exact number joins the icon button's accessible name («Уведомления, 5 непрочитанных») and the badge's tooltip. On an anchor of size 1/3 or 1/2 a count is drawn as a dot.

badge-dot.description: A dot on the icon button, a count with no number: something new. Shown when badge-count is not set; with a count, the count is drawn as a dot. Its text equivalent («есть новое» / «new» by default, badge-label to change it) joins the accessible name.

badge-cap.description: The largest count drawn as a number; a larger one reads «<cap>+».

badge-label.description: The words the badge adds to the accessible name and its tooltip, in place of the page language's default: for a dot the whole text equivalent; for a count the phrase in plural forms separated by «|» (one|few|many in Russian, one|other in English) with {count} where the number goes.

pressed.description: Whether this toggle button is on: aria-pressed on the native button and the pressed look -- the primary container fill, its ink, no visible edge and the icon filled (rule C12); pressed="false" says off; absent, the button is not a toggle and nothing is said

label-pressed.description: The accessible name while the toggle is on, for a toggle whose name changes («Добавить в избранное» → «Убрать из избранного»). Set, the name says the state and aria-pressed is not written; the pressed look still follows pressed. Empty: aria-label stays the name and aria-pressed says the state

theme-cycle.description: A ready theme switch over SF.Loader's theme (the contract of sf-segmented's theme-switch: themePreference, setTheme, sf-theme-change). Present and empty: three values, «as the system», light and dark, in the owner's order -- first the theme opposite to the visible one, then the other, then «as the system» (rule D11d); "light dark": two values, every press flips the visible theme. The icons are contrast, light_mode and dark_mode; the words are the page language's («Тема: светлая. Нажмите — тёмная»). cycle is ignored beside it.

value.description: The current item of a cycle (its value); a press writes the next one. Read it from the attribute or from change: the value property keeps the settings object it has always given.

type.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

variant.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

button-attributes.description: Attributes an external project template may put on its button; the built-in template does not read them

cycle.description: One button, several values (rule D11d): the items {value, label, icon, pressed?} a press steps through, wrapping at the end. value is the current item. The name and the icon say the current value («Повтор: один трек»), the tooltip says the current and the next, and a polite live region says the new value after a press; change {previous, value, item} follows. Not a toggle: pressed and label-pressed are ignored beside it, with one console warning.

setButtonAttributes.summary: Passes the object to setState() as buttonAttributes; the built-in template does not read it, so it only reaches an external project template. Returns the element.

onClick.summary: Adds a listener for click on the host. Returns the element.

onFocus.summary: Adds a listener for focusin on the host. Returns the element.

onBlur.summary: Adds a listener for focusout on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseEnter.summary: Adds a listener for mouseenter on the host. Returns the element.

onMouseLeave.summary: Adds a listener for mouseleave on the host. Returns the element.

setDisabled.summary: Sets the disabled attribute when nextValue is truthy and removes it otherwise. Returns the element.

change.summary: A cycle (cycle or theme-cycle) moved to its next value after a person's press; dispatched on the host, bubbles and is composed, after press on sf-button. A theme cycle sends it after SF.Loader.setTheme has drawn the theme. Not sent by a button that is not a cycle.

item.description: The item now current: {value, label, icon, lang, pressed}.

accessibility.focus: The inner native button is the only focus owner. Pointer activation does not show the ring; keyboard focus uses focus-visible, with an inset ring inside joined controls.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button-icon for a compact action that is unambiguous from one familiar icon and has a concise accessible name.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not omit aria-label when no visible text names the action
Do not use the large-surface radius as a normal control variation
Do not keep a loading action enabled
